children: Bank of America kept its Buy rating on Apple
after CEO John Ternus delivered his first product event, but lowered its price objective as softer-than-expected pricing threatened margins.
The bank reduced its Apple target to $370 from $380. From the referenced share price of $315.34, the new objective implies approximately 17% upside.

Analysts said the foldable iPhone Duo stole the show, introducing Apple's most meaningful form-factor change in years. Its folding display supports iPad-like productivity, while planned Pencil compatibility, FaceTime dual capture and optimized apps could help the device become mainstream.
Why Bank of America Lowered Apple's Target
The concern is not demand. New iPhone pricing came below expectations, potentially supporting higher sales volumes while pressuring gross margins as memory and component costs rise.

The firm raised its iPhone unit estimates by 2 million devices for fiscal 2026 and 5 million for fiscal 2027. However, the smaller-than-expected increase in average selling prices prompted earnings reductions. Its calendar 2027 earnings estimate fell to $9.98 per share from $10.32.

Bank of America maintained the 37-times earnings multiple used in its valuation, meaning the lower target reflects reduced profit expectations rather than weakening confidence in Apple's long-term strategy.

Ternus emphasized Apple's focus on integrating hardware, software and services while protecting customer privacy. He described the iPhone as an intelligent personal hub capable of understanding user context. New devices will run some AI models on-device and send more complex requests through Private Cloud Compute.
The event also introduced upgraded iPhone 18 Pro models, Apple Watches and AirPods featuring improved processors, cameras, battery performance and health capabilities.

For investors, the report presents a balanced signal: stronger unit demand and product innovation support the Buy thesis, but lower pricing and rising input costs could limit near-term earnings leverage. Future upside depends on Duo adoption, product mix and Apple's ability to preserve margins.

title: BofA Tweaks Apple Stock Price Target After Ternus Debut
